observations.body: Scripture gathers every mouth under sin. What then? Are we better than they? No, in no way. For we previously warned both Jews and Greeks that they are all under sin. Because by the works of the law, no flesh will be justified in his sight; for through the law comes the knowledge of sin.

payload.tension: The passage states scripture gathers every mouth under sin. What then? Are we better than they? No, in no way. For we previously warned both Jews and Greeks that they are all under sin. Because by the works of the law, no flesh will be justified in his sight; for through the law comes the knowledge of sin.
